category: inference endpoint, decentralised GPU network, trial credit behind a payment method

free_tier.stated: Trial credits are granted when a payment method is verified during onboarding; the amount is not stated on the current documentation pages. A launch post of 22 November 2025 stated 'New accounts receive $100 in AI token credits'. Trial credits expire; purchased credits do not.

tooling: OpenAI-compatible REST at https://api.akashml.com/v1 and an Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint at https://api.akashml.com/anthropic; any SDK with a custom base URL
chaining: a drop-in base URL for OpenAI and Anthropic clients once a payment method is on file; the documentation carries a Claude Code guide that points the Messages endpoint at open models

limits.value: unpublished platform-wide; each API key carries optional caps set by its owner for requests per minute, tokens per minute and concurrent requests, and a request over a cap returns HTTP 429 with X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset and Retry-After headers
trial credit of unstated size that expires; HTTP 402 is returned when credits run out

binding_note: the trial credit balance is the only free resource and it expires; once spent, every request needs purchased credit

identity_cost.detail: an email address (or a Google or GitHub sign-in) is verified at signup, and a payment method must be verified during onboarding before trial credits are granted; payments run through Stripe

confidence_note: documentation pages only; the size of the current trial credit sits behind the signed-in dashboard and is unverified
